howTitle.en: Order by the tonne, pave by the degree

howP.en: Tonnage is geometry times density: area × compacted thickness × 2.4 t/m³ for typical AC-13. The two things that blow budgets are not in that formula. First, waste: truck beds are sprayed with release oil and every joint gets hand-worked, so 3–6% leaves the site one way or another. Second, temperature: mix that arrives below 135 °C cannot compact and becomes a very expensive speed bump. Order for the paver's real output, not the plant's maximum.
howP.zh: 吨数就是几何乘密度：面积 × 压实厚度 × 2.4t/m³（AC-13 常用值）。真正打爆预算的两件事不在这个公式里。一是损耗：车厢喷隔离油、每条接缝都要人工找补，3–6% 总会流走。二是温度：到场低于 135°C 的料压不实，最后变成一块非常昂贵的减速带。按摊铺机的真实产能订料，别按拌和站的最大产能。

a.en: It is the safe middle for dense-graded hot mix: AC-13 runs about 2.38–2.42, coarser AC-25 about 2.45, SMA closer to 2.5 because of the stone skeleton. If the plant ticket quotes a bulk density, use theirs — asphalt's density moves with bitumen content, and bitumen prices move weekly.
a.zh: 2.4 是密级配热拌料的稳妥中值：AC-13 约 2.38–2.42，粗粒式 AC-25 约 2.45，SMA 靠粗骨料骨架能到 2.5。拌和站小票上如果标了体积分散密度，用他们的——沥青密度跟油石比走，油石比跟着油价每周变。

q.zh: 厚度填压实后还是松铺？

a.en: Compacted — that is what you measure and pay for. Pavers lay loose at roughly 1.25–1.35× the compacted target and the roller takes out the rest, so a 5 cm finish needs about a 6.5 cm loose mat. Never order loose tonnage; the plant sells tonnes, the roller sells compaction.
a.zh: 压实厚度——那是你量得出、付得值的。摊铺机松铺系数约 1.25–1.35，压路机把剩下的压掉，5cm 成品要摊 6.5cm 左右的松铺层。但订料永远按压实吨数：拌和站卖的是吨，压路机交付的是密实度。

q.en: Why is my supplier's tonnage higher than this?
q.zh: 为什么供应商报的吨数比这里高？

a.en: Three honest reasons: they include the loose-to-compacted factor, they round every truck to a full load (mix plants do not sell 0.3 t), and they carry their own waste. Ask for the calculation, not just the number — a supplier who won't show it is pricing something you should see.
a.zh: 三个正当理由：他们把松铺系数算进去了、每车凑整（拌和站不卖 0.3 吨）、他们自己也留了损耗。要他给你算式而不只是结果——不肯给算式的供应商，报价里一定有你该看见的东西。

q.en: Do I calculate each layer separately?

a.en: Yes — surface, binder and base layers usually differ in mix price, density and paving rate, and the base layer tonnage dwarfs the surface. Total the per-layer costs at the end; a single average price across layers hides exactly the money you are trying to see.
a.zh: 要——面层、中面层、基层的料价、密度、摊铺单价通常都不同，基层吨数还远大于面层。分层算完最后加总；用一个平均价套所有层，藏的恰恰是你想看清的那笔钱。
